description_excerpt: Role Purpose: Accountable for the end-to-end financial operations of logistics services within the assigned scope – from rate management and order-to-cash (billing, invoicing, collection follow-up) to procure-to-pay (carrier/vendor cost accrual, purchase orders, invoice matching and payment follow-up). The role leads a team of FINOPS professionals to deliver accurate, timely and compliant financial transactions, protect revenue and margin, reduce unbilled and aged items, and continuously improve processes through standardization, automation and digital tools.
